description: Crawls a site from the start URL, following internal links (same domain) and linked PDFs, and returns one record per page: url, title, view, type (html|pdf), text, tables. Obeys robots.txt. Results are also written to a JSONL file whose path is returned.

click.description: CSS selector of tabs/buttons to click on single-page apps, saving every view

follow.description: Only follow links whose URL contains this text, e.g. /docs/

format.description: text (default) or markdown, which keeps headings, lists, links and tables

js.description: Render pages in headless Chromium for JavaScript sites (slower)

max_pages.description: Stop after this many pages (0 = no limit)

pdf.description: Also download linked PDFs and extract their text and tables

name: crawl
title: Crawl a website into clean text
